description: Fernwärmeleitungsnetz Stadtwerke Clausthal GmbH is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data includes the district heating supply network Clausthal-Zellerfeld. District heating enters the connected buildings via pipes. The principle is simple: For heat generation, gas flows into an internal combustion engine. Kinetic energy and thus heat are released. The burned gas turns into 2/3 heat and 1/3 electricity. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "District heating network Stadtwerke Clausthal GmbH" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wärmeerzeugung, Energieerzeugung, thermische Energie, inspireidentifiziert, Städtische Energieversorgung, Fernwärmeversorgung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
